slug: 2025-11-05 Algeria approves draft law on national digital ID and trust services

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers approved a draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, which includes a national digital identification system linked to the biometric national ID card; the bill moves to the next legislative stage.
facts.system: Draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification

facts.fact: The Algerian government approved on 2 November 2025 a draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, which introduces a national digital identification framework based on the existing biometric identity card and updates the 2015 e-signature law.

facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior lists law 14-03 of 24 February 2014 on travel titles and documents among the texts governing issuance of passports and identity cards.

The Ministry of the Interior says executive decree 10-210 of 16 September 2010 instituted the national identification number (NIN) and requires it on official identity, circulation and travel documents.
